title: The page's side of the five telemetry lanes: data/telemetry.json gains `lanes`, and assets/telemetry.js tries them in turn (507, 404 or 5xx moves on); no caps of any kind
note: The editor's decision of 27 October: no caps anywhere (no per-tab limit, no crawler filter, no 'capped' marker), because he wants every indexed page counted; keep the five lanes as they are. The code, for the lanes only, is in records/briefs/2026-10-27__brief__five-lanes-and-a-cap-per-tab.md (replaced the same evening). If the script has any limit today, remove it; it had none on 27 October. Context: on 26 October one Googlebot session sent 960 events and filled the lane for about 4¾ hours, after the six-repository rebuild (the editor's reading: a re-crawl of the whole site). assets/telemetry.js is in the press (security's review); the five tokens are in the telemetry vault's identity/lanes.json and observability will hand them to dev.
